name: A Platinum
description: A Platinum This autoclave combines advanced performance with operational efficiency and environment-friendliness. Three models with load volumes of 17, 22, and 28 litres are available: each model has the same external dimensions. An innovative water treatment system lets users perform up to 50 sterilization cycles with just 5 litres of tap water. View video Download the brochure 7'’ touchscreen The 7" HD display provides access to autoclave use and maintenance tutorials that provide instructions on a variety of topics, from correct load positioning to periodic maintenance. What’s more, users can consult cycle reports saved on the device at any time. Water savings Thanks to the integrated recirculation filter, which demineralises and purifies the water used, A Platinum consumes just 100 ml of tap water per cycle. This means that reservoirs of demineralised water no longer need to be stored in the practice. Cycle times and Modular Drying The high performance of the internal components - combined with a control system that optimises each phase - reduces sterilization cycle times significantly. The Modular Drying function lets users select the load quantity. This adapts the duration of drying, thus shortening cycle times further: for example, a B cycle can be completed in just 31 minutes. Printer and QR code The optional printer can be shared by multiple sterilizers on the same network, optimising use of space by allowing for a single printing station. At the end of the cycle, adhesive labels with QR codes can be printed: these provide data on the sterilizer itself, the cycle performed, the result and the bag expiry date, thus ensuring full traceability. Labels with barcodes and cycle reports can also be printed. Advanced traceability and NFC sensor QR code and Barcode labels optimise traceability control; the SterilConnect App and MyTrace platform extend sterile load monitoring capabilities. Remaining on the topic of traceability, activating user ID ensures only authorised personnel are able to access the device functions. The NFC card, supplied with the sterilizer and associated with the user, streamlines the login procedure. Cloud connectivity and Sterilconnect Highly useful for saving cycle reports, monitoring the device or accessing video tutorials, manuals and usage statistics. EasyCheck - a cloud platform designed for technicians - provides fast access to remote assistance. With the Sterilconnect app, instead, you can interact with the autoclave, manage processes and monitor its operation from a connected mobile device.

At the end of the cycle, adhesive labels with QR codes can be printed: these provide data on the sterilizer itself, the cycle performed, the result and the bag expiry date, thus ensuring full traceability. name: Thalya
description: Thalya Regular care is a must to ensure the lasting performance of rotating instruments. Once the instruments have been cleaned, disinfected and dried, Thalya lubricates them so they are ready for sterilization and subsequent use. name: Thalya Plus
description: Thalya Plus When a rotating instrument slows down, its internal components may suck liquids into the conduits, with a high risk of cross-contamination. Consequently, each instrument needs to undergo an effective cycle that neutralises such risks. Thalya Plus has been designed to automate rotary device/scaler maintenance by performing cleaning and disinfection, lubrication (except for scalers), purging and drying, all in a single cycle. A complete cycle in 12 minutes The complete cycle has 6 stages: Duct purge Internal cleansing Internal and external disinfection Lubrication Excess oil purge Drying The 4 instruments are treated simultaneously and the entire cycle lasts about 12 minutes. Up to 4 instruments simultaneously Thalya Plus can treat up to 4 instruments simultaneously: turbines, micromotor handpieces and scalers. To perform treatment, all that’s needed is the dedicated adapter. The couplings can rotate 45°, making it easier to place and remove instruments. Maximum flexibility Specific adapters ensure micromotor handpieces are rotated, allowing detergent, disinfectant and lubricant to reach and fully cover the internal surfaces of the instrument and so maximise treatment efficiency. Cycle traceability Thanks to the USB port at the rear of the machine, users can download machine cycle reports. An indispensable tool for correct reconditioning process traceability. Detergent and disinfectant Although equipped with two separate tanks, useful for separating the cycle phases and providing greater control, Thalya Plus uses a single product that acts as both a detergent and a disinfectant, simplifying daily tasks and reducing the risk of operator error. Connectivity Thalya Plus features an integrated Wi-Fi module. Connected to the Internet connection, this device offers all the benefits of EasyCheck remote assistance.

name: Tethys
description: Tethys Available in 3 versions, Tethys is built with materials of the highest quality, guaranteeing outstanding performance and full compliance with current standards. Download the brochure Three models Available in 45 cm (Tethys T45) and 60 cm (Tethys D60 and Tethys T60) versions, these dental instrument disinfection devices can be placed underneath the worktop, making them easy to install whatever the dental practice sterilization room layout. The D60 model also has a drying function. Practicality and flexibility The machine maximises configuration flexibility and is easily adapted to the different needs of the dental practice. The D60 and T60 models have connections for hot and cold water - both treated with the incorporated water softener - and demineralised water. Using hot water significantly reduces cycle times. The T45 model, instead, has no hot water connection. The electrical system of the machine also offers extensive flexibility. The T60 and D60 models are supplied as standard with a 400 V three-phase power supply, which can easily be converted to 230 V using a practical kit. The T45, instead, operates with a 230 V single-phase power supply. Process safety The new Tethys series has been designed and manufactured in compliance EN 15883. This means the machines meet the most recent washing-disinfection requirements, providing wash cycles that can be controlled, verified and repeated. Touch controls The durable glass front panel with soft-touch controls allows complete, easy control of the device. The LCD displays all the information relating to operation, with dynamic display of key parameters such as time, temperature and phase during the execution of each cycle. Traceability Tethys models give users complete control over thermal disinfection processes, as required by EN 15883. Reports on completed cycles are saved on the internal memory of the device and can be downloaded via the frontal USB port. Accessories Anthos has a wide range of accessories that allow users to get the most out of the machine according to the material to be treated. The models can be supplied with optional baskets to treat specific devices.

name: Tethys H10
description: Tethys H10 Excellent performance with a quick and easy workflow: this thermal disinfector replaces some of the manual tasks typically required during the pre-sterilization stages, lightening the workload for staff and reducing the risks associated with handling the material. Download the brochure 4 stages, 1 process. Tethys H10 makes the reconditioning process even simpler and more practical. Pre-washing, washing, thermal disinfection and drying are performed as a single, fast, automatic process. One cycle thus eliminates all risk for the operators and completes the phases that precede instrument packaging and sterilization. Complete cycles and cycle times Pre-wash, ultrasonic wash, rinse, thermal disinfection, and hot air drying: all in just 35 minutes. Tethys H10 is the only thermal disinfector able to shorten cycle times to such an unprecedented extent. Compliance with ISO15883 Tethys H10 is an EN ISO 15883-1/2-certified medical device with a wash cycle based on the combined action of detergent and ultrasound and a 90°C thermal disinfection stage. To conclude the cycle, a hot air flow dries the instruments perfectly. Ease of use The touchscreen is designed to ensure smooth, comprehensive interaction: simply and intuitively, it lets users select the most suitable program from a range of pre-configured or personalised options. Complete and compact An automatic door lock system prevents accidental opening during the process, thus ensuring safety. Performance is consistent and ensured by the high-pressure wash pump and drain pump. The Aqua-Stop system protects users from any water leaks. Minimal running costs Tethys H10 uses hot water to thermally disinfect contaminated material effectively. Since no chemical disinfectants are used, operating costs are significantly reduced. Connectivity and traceability Tethys H10 integrates with the practice network to allow data sharing. The device and its internal data can be managed remotely. Once connected to the Internet, assistance also becomes more convenient. Each device allows cycle reports to be downloaded via a USB port.

name: Millseal+ Evo
description: Millseal+ Evo Automatic version: Millseal+ Evo is able to manage the entire material packaging procedure, from preparation of the pouches to their final sealing. Motorized adjustment of pouch length ensures maximum precision, thus optimising paper consumption. A programme for every need The machine has two operating programmes, P1 and P2. These allow the operator to customise the pouch length and quantity parameters. Once one of the two programs has been selected and started, the machine automatically prepares pouches, sealed at one end, of the desired length and quantity. This feature saves the practice a significant amount of time by automating a traditionally long, demanding operation. Note, however, that the device can still be used in manual mode via the user-friendly keypad. Practical display Programme selection is simple and immediate. Operating parameters are kept under control at all times thanks to the large display showing the selected settings (length and number of pouches) for the pouch preparation procedure. Guaranteed sterilization Millseal+ Evo dental thermal sealers are equipped with electronic parameter control (time and sealing temperature) and guarantee a 12 mm wide sealing band, well in excess of legal requirements Furthermore, visual-acoustic messages provide information on sealer efficiency.

name: Millseal+ Manual
description: Millseal+ Manual The Millseal+ Manual dental thermal sealer allows the operator to freely select the length of the pouch, cut it and seal it using simple manual procedures. A confirmation beep guarantees the quality and consistency of the sealing process. Consistent performance Automatic temperature adjustment ensures fine heating control of the sealing bar, maintaining long-lasting high quality performance. What’s more, the thermal sealer also features an overheating protection system and an automatic energy-saving standby mode. Practical ergonomic design The machine is designed to optimise use of space by maximising the number of paper rolls managed while minimising the surface area occupied on the work top. The positioning system keeps the paper in place and prevents rewinding of the roll after cutting and sealing, providing a linear, uninterrupted procedure. Easier pouch management The roll holder allows up to three rolls to be housed simultaneously, with a maximum width of 300 mm. Roller changeovers are fast and user-friendly.
